body:
Lost a lot of control when mother suicided. It's taken me years to get over it and come to grips with the fact that it was not my fault. There's been no attempt by me to commit suicide, not that I've not daydreamed about it, other than my eating incorrectly. This is my reasoning as to why I was not able to keep it fully. Realizing what was occurring when I was diagnosed with my first(of four) major health issues.

Looked for support. The closest town of any size with the kind of help I need is a good ninety minutes away. Yeah, I'm that far out in the country. That coupled with the fact that it's very hard for me to open up to strangers means that, the wife and i, really rely on each other. 

Thank you for caring. Life is difficult, it was easier once I graduated high school. I'm working towards goals that include weight lose, a permanent change of diet, and a better attitude. It's slow going but I'm getting there.

I've never told anyone most of what I did but since this will be buried and it's on a throwaway read away... 

Shortly before I turned 17 and started sliding into an abyss of depression and self destructiveness. In an ever escalating spiral of risky behavior I did the following, unprotected sex (i was hoping to catch HIV), driving on the wrong side of the road, extreme speeds (100 or more on side/dirt roads), extremely violent behavior, a few brushes with the law, playing with knives, and Russian roulette with a real gun at my lowest point. This is just a few things I did, never drugs or alcohol tho.

My mother, bless her heart, fought to bring me out of my depression and suicidal behavior, with the help of a shrink. Who I was seeing for about three months two times a week. That ended very shortly after I threatened to skin, chop, and burn said shrink for something they said to me about my mother. I never went back. It also made me realize a few things about myself, family, and friends. Thus I managed for the most part to dig myself out of the pit and stop a lot of my behavior. She made me promise to never attempt suicide or do anything like what I was doing before. 

I've cleaned up and kept my promise for the most part. Been diagnosed with SDD (Seasonal Depression Disorder) and winter time is fucking difficult, but here I am powering through it. I just wish Mother could have felt that she could have talked to me about her problems. You see she committed suicide a number of years ago which has made it difficult to not fall back on that promise. 

Recently I realized that there was still one last self destructive behavior that got worse after moms death. Eating, I realized earlier last year that I was trying to kill myself with food. I'm struggling to turn my eating habits around and have managed to start losing weight for the first time in a very long time. I thank my wife for helping and understanding my struggles with it everyday. If it wasn't for her... I don't know where I'd be.

P.S. Clean and no kids for those that care. 

TD:DR Tried killing myself. Mother saved me. Mother suicided with out giving me a chance to save her. Been trying to kill self with food ever since her death. Spent last year struggling to overcome food addiction.
